name: What happens after I receive my roof replacement estimate?

mainEntity.name: What happens after I receive my roof replacement estimate?

acceptedAnswer.text: After receiving your roof replacement estimate, you'll have time to review the details and ask any questions you may have. We encourage you to reach out to clarify any part of the proposal. Once you're ready to proceed, we'll discuss scheduling the project at your convenience. This typically involves confirming material availability and coordinating permits, especially in specific service areas like Allen where local regulations apply.
acceptedAnswer.description: After receiving your estimate, review it, ask questions, and then we'll discuss scheduling, material availability, and necessary permits.
